notes.title: Little Legend Kickstarter is LIVE!
notes.content:
https://media.giphy.com/media/ycpOXcjElz6okgdoB4/giphy.gif

Hello, Adventurers!

We are excited to announce that the Kickstarter for Little Legend is LIVE!
You can watch the trailer for the game and learn about it's univers here:

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34320554/76aa68bd144c0806ff68007d0bd5a24301637f82.png

You can also follow us on our social media channels

Read about us on Twitter
Ask us questions on Discord
Like and Share us on Facebook

All support, retweets, likes, are really appreciated!
We count on you to spread the word!

We will regularly post updates about our progression - so please be sure to add Little Legend to your Wishlist and Follow the game to see every new update as soon as it drops!

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34320554/5f701891481b8a236ad66f9893432d59ed224302.gif

Thank you :)

The NEVERMIND Team
